entities.name: Loren
entities.description: Elf Scout and Master Scout of Havenwood, son of Thelon, ambushed by Morgan.

entities.name: Thelon
entities.description: Loren's father, who helped engineer thallids.

entities.name: Morgan
entities.description: Thelonite druid who ambushed Loren to spark war against the thallids.

entities.name: Tev Loneglade
entities.description: Planeswalker who rescued Loren with a fireball.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Sentient fungus whose growth Loren scouted.

events.summary: Elves split into factions when thallids gain sentience, and Loren is sent to scout their growth.
events.quote: Loren's final mission would be to scout the thallids' growth and report on their condition.

events.summary: Morgan ambushes Loren, who is trapped and webbed by thallids.
Tev Loneglade rescues Loren with a fireball.
events.quote: rescued Loren from the fatal trap with a powerful fireball

events.summary: Morgan ambushes Loren again and shoots him with a poison arrow, revealing his plan to start war.
events.quote: this time taking a poison arrow to the chest

relations.note: Morgan tried to kill him and frame his family.
relations.quote: he wished to declare Loren and his family traitors
